title: Arcade Classics
description:
Blast your way through wave after wave of asteroids and enemy spaceships, break away at bricks until you reveal the beautiful night sky, or defend Earth from an alien invasion in an adrenaline-pumping battle!

CHALLENGE YOURSELF OLD SCHOOL

Enjoy a challenging collection of arcade classics, all remade in a friendly pixelated art style and a beautiful soundtrack. Try to best your highscore and get all the achievements.

The games start easy but become quite challenging as you progress. Everything becomes faster, enemies become more aggressive, and powerups and extra lives more rare.

Astro ImpactFight off wave after wave of asteroids and enemy ships with one of 3 spaceships available to you, all with different abilities. With each wave the number of asteroids increases and the enemies become more aggressive, making you work harder and harder.

Pick one of 3 ships before you go into action:

Brick SmashColorful bricks are covering the night sky and it's up to you to destroy them so the citizens can get a clear view of the beautiful stars. Use either of the 2 distinct paddles and balls, and combine them and their capabilities to get as far as you can. Watch out for exploding bricks and try to avoid the nasty reverse control "powerup". Mind you; as you progress things get faster.

Select a loadout of paddle and ball to help you destroy the bricks:

Alien AssaultThe aliens are invading, and it's up to you to stop them! Take control of your tank and defend Earth against waves of alien attackers. Will you choose the agile tank, capable of quick dodges and fast attacks, or the slower one with a stronger cannon? As you progress, the invaders become faster and more challenging, pushing your reflexes to the limit.

Pick one of 2 tanks for defending Earth:

Have fun blasting through asteroids, crushing bricks, and saving Earth from alien invasions in this tiny arcade collection!
description_short: Collection of a few arcade classics, remade with a fresh and friendly looking art style and a beautiful soundtrack.
